title: Do not build red with $95 reserve
description: Do not build red with $95 reserve. A red house is tempting, but cash reserve is too low against built orange. The decision depends on house supply, immediate rent threat, and whether the reserve survives the build.

final_action.public_message: Mortgaging my Reading Railroad to raise cash.
final_action.private_thought: Need cash to survive potential rent on Kentucky (Beta's property). Mortgage Reading Railroad for $100, raising cash to $195, enough to cover rent if landed on Kentucky. This is safe and preserves other assets.
